Description: The SDIO Standard Function code identifies those I/O functions which implement the recommended standard interface as defined in a separate Application Specification. Codes: 0h: No SDIO standard interface supported; 1h: SDIO Standard UART; 2h: SDIO Bluetooth Type-A; 3h: SDIO Bluetooth Type-B; 4h: GPS; 5h: Camera; 6h: PHS; 7h: WLAN; 8h-Eh: Reserved; Fh: Check Extended code in n01h

If this function supports and contains a Code Storage Area (CSA) this bit shall be set to 1. If this function does not support a CSA this bit shall be cleared to 0. CSA enable is controlled by bit 7 of register n00h.

This bit controls access to the Code Storage Area for this function. If cleared to 0 any read or write access to the CSA shall be blocked. If set to 1 access to the CSA is allowed. Cleared to 0 upon reset. If function does not support CSA (0n00h bit 6=0) then this bit shall be R/O and always read as 0.

Field: Extended SDIO Standard Function interface code
Description: This is the extension of the SDIO Standard Function interface code. If the SDIO Standard Function interface code is greater than Eh then this byte shall contain the code and the standard code (100h bits 3-0) shall contain a value of Fh. If the standard code is less than Fh then this byte shall be 00h.

Support Power Selection. This bit indicates if the function has Power Selection. SPS=0: This function has no Power Selection; EPS shall be zero. SPS=1: This function has 2 power modes which are selected by EPS. This bit is effective when EMPC=1 in CCCR and PS[3:0]=0.

Enable Power Selection. EPS=0 (default): The function operates in Higher Current Mode; maximum current given in TPLFE_HP_MAX_PWR_3.3V. EPS=1: The function works in Lower Current Mode; maximum current given in TPLFE_LP_MAX_PWR_3.3V. This bit shall be reset when IOEx=0. Effective when EMPC=1 in CCCR and PS[3:0]=0.

Power State PS[3:0]. If PS[3:0] is set to 0 TPL_CODE CISTPL_FUNCE (22h) extension 01h is used and the card power is controlled by EMPC and EPS (SDIO Version 2.00 Compatible Mode). If non-zero the card power state is specified in the PS table defined in CISTPL_FUNCE extension 04h.

This 16-bit register sets the block size for I/O block operations for each function (1-7). If block operations not supported (SMB=0) this register is read-only and reads 0000h. Maximum block size is 2048 (0800h) minimum is 1 (0001h). At power-up or reset initially loaded with 0000h. Host responsible for setting appropriate value. Stored in little-endian format (LSB first).
